## Story DD Coverage
(None — pure refactor; DD ownership implicit via task-4 gate which imports from this module.)

Extract common attestation logic (git verify-commit + bot-allowlist check) from plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/orphan_band.py into new module plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/_attestation.py. Refactor orphan_band.py to import from _attestation.py in the same task. Justified by 2 confirmed call sites (orphan_band.py + stale_band.py from this story). Pre-existing orphan_band attestation tests must continue to pass unchanged.

## TDD Test Spec
Given a commit signed by an allowlisted reviewer and an attested.json referencing that SHA; When _attestation.verify_attested_commit(sha, allowlist) is called; Then it returns True. Given a bot-signed commit; Then it returns False without raising. Given orphan_band.py's existing test suite; Then all assertions pass unchanged after the refactor.

## testing_mode: RED
